about: Each case is a claim of the work report (report.md) that breaks P7 (review stage). before/ holds the project at the commit the work began on, and project/ the project as the work leaves it. 'code' names the rule of cg.py claims that finds its part, or null when only judgement can. '@report' is the work report of the built project. A finding catches a case when its pointer is 'file' at the line that holds 'text', three lines either way, or is one of 'or', where 'record' is a record under .cg-docs/evidence/. 'work' is the work as it went: for each slice the checks that ran. 'claims' has the runner run cg.py claims once every slice is done, as the work playbook does.

review.flag: a claim labelled measured that points at a record that is not there
a number that is not the one its output holds
a claim labelled measured with no pointer
review.text: every region of the survey has a row

review.flag: a function named that the project does not define
a file the Changed table names that the change left as it was
an inference written as fact, with no label
a pointer that does not show what is claimed
nothing said of what was not checked
